originality.rationale: Published source [1, section 2.3] proves the two-plateau obstruction only for even N>=12, and its formula does not classify the small periodic grids. The new exact boundary is N=6, with explicit N=6/8 output polynomials and a convex-entropy nonincrease certificate for N=2/4. Wei--Shu [2] addresses another spatial degree, initial data and entropy. published-finding corpus aliases/source/parameter searches found no dominating statement; priority remains subject to incomplete indexing and possible uncatalogued treatments.
residual_risks: An uncatalogued preprint or unpublished small-mesh computation could have anticipated the cutoff.
The result is not a global entropy-stability theorem for arbitrary P1 DG states or general numerical fluxes.
